stop_condition:
Report HIGH only for: a route by which the recovery selects a record it should not; an
unsound premise in the append-only position argument; a regression of K3's refuse-on-
ambiguity; a legitimate value the writer guard now wrongly rejects; or any remaining
permanent-deadlock path. MEDIUM/LOW otherwise. If there is no HIGH, say so plainly.

findings.evidence: The recovery assumes NR reflects insertion order, but the supported bd 1.2.2 path returns comments with `ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC` (internal/storage/issueops/comments.go:24-29). Imported comments preserve their supplied created_at (internal/storage/issueops/create.go:620-648), and this repository's mandatory reconciliation explicitly runs `bd import` (.claude/scripts/beads-ledger.sh:597). Therefore a malformed comment imported after a well-formed winner can carry an older created_at, appear before that winner in `$firstlines`, and satisfy `maxbadpos < winpos`.
findings.description: The append-only position premise is unsound: storage insertion order is discarded in favor of a preserved, backfillable timestamp. A later-imported malformed record may represent a newer round that should force refusal, yet the selector treats it as safely historical and selects the existing winner. This is a concrete route by which recovery selects a record it should not.
